roles.title: Principal Product Manager, Kitchen Operations & Innovation

bullets: Own and drive the KDS product strategy — enterprise workflow depth, data differentiation, SMB attach growth, and the agentic AI roadmap — connecting investments to Toast’s kitchen…
Define where agentic AI creates real value in the kitchen: proactive prep time adjustments based on real-time order load, automatic kitchen configuration changes tied to labor…
Own KDS delivery end-to-end, working directly with large restaurant groups to translate complex, high-stakes workflow requirements into scalable product decisions that serve the…
Lead the KDS kitchen data strategy: define what kitchen efficiency insights should look like for operators at every scale, from API-first analytics for enterprise operators to…
Shape and validate the business case for the next-generation KDS strategy — the long-horizon bets that drive future growth.
Own the product roadmap for Toast Capital (Toast’s flagship lending product).
Work closely with cross functional teams and various product domains across Toast to support ideation, design, development, launch and support of new and existing products.
Create & present business cases and business models for new product investments, and measure/quantify success of product launches.
Write technical and non-technical user stories, define requirements, workflows, and wireframes in collaboration with Engineering, Design, Data Science and other teams.
Manage the backlog of an established engineering team, define roadmap requirements, and facilitate agile ceremonies.
Marketing automation: Lead the vision, strategy and roadmap for Toast’s marketing experiences across email, SMS and social. Partner with our CRM team and own the marketing use…
Advanced tooling: Build the power-user layer for Toast’s marketing specialists, multi-location brands, and sophisticated operators, including bulk and multi-location workflows…
AI: Partner with the Toast IQ Marketing Agent team so that AI-generated campaigns are easy to review, edit, approve, and trust. Find where AI can remove work across the campaign…
Metrics: Own outcomes for your area, acting as the GM of the product space. You’ll be accountable for campaigns sent, attributed revenue and marketing specialist efficiency.
Teamwork: Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to define and deliver high-impact features.

roles.title: Principal Product Manager, Enterprise Change Management

bullets: Own and evolve the product strategy for Toast’s configuration platform, with a focus on:
Designing systems that safely manage changes to critical business data, including validation, versioning, auditability, and rollback at scale
Building and evolving a configuration platform that works for SMB, multi-unit operator, and Enterprise use cases across the Toast experience
Exploring and integrating automation and AI-assisted (‘agentic’) workflows into configuration and publishing experiences
Build platform capabilities that enable other Toast teams to develop, test, and deploy configuration-driven features independently
